collegeFullAddress: College of Engineering Pune, Wellesley Road, Shivajinagar, Pune, Maharashtra 411005
collegeInfo: Established in 1854, COEP is one of Asia’s oldest engineering colleges. It achieved Technological University status in 2022 and offers world-class UG, PG & doctoral degrees in engineering and technology. Renowned for innovation, entrepreneurship, and industry connections, COEP’s alumni network reaches global leadership roles.

events.eventFullDescription: MindSpark is COEP’s flagship national techfest featuring robotics, coding, hackathons, workshops, exhibitions, quizzes, and project showcases. It attracts thousands of tech enthusiasts each year.
Regatta is COEP’s iconic annual boat festival on the Mula river, blending engineering, tradition, and a vibrant display of boating maneuvers, attracting alumni and guests citywide.
Impressions is COEP’s grand annual inter-collegiate cultural fest witnessing theatrical, musical, dance, art, photography, and culinary competitions, along with star performances.
Zest is COEP’s annual sports festival, bringing together athletes across Maharashtra for events in cricket, football, basketball, volleyball, and athletics.

infrastructure.infraDescription: The 36-acre COEP campus features heritage and smart classrooms, central library, 9+ boys' and girls' hostels, innovation labs, sports complex, gym, swimming pool, multistorey academic building, campus Wi-Fi, riverfront, canteen, and a boating club unique in the country.
